name: Washington

response.rule_text: Within 5 business days the body must produce the records, deny, or acknowledge with a reasonable estimate of the time needed. That is a response or estimate requirement, not a production deadline, so no day count is stored.

fees.labor_rule: No fees for inspection or locating records (RCW 42.56.120); customized requests must be agreed in advance.
fees.copy_rule: Default $0.15 per page, $0.10 per scanned page, $0.05 per four electronic files, flat fee up to $2 per request; higher rates only if shown necessary to recover actual cost.
fees.waiver_rule: Allowed if the agency has adopted a rule providing for it (RCW 42.56.120(4)).
fees.late_penalty: Court may award penalties up to $100 per day of denial, plus costs and attorney fees (RCW 42.56.550(4), 42.56.505(4)).

residency.rule_text: Any person may request records; no need to know is required (RCW 42.56.080).

appeal.body: Optional Attorney General review (RCW 42.56.530, non-binding), then civil suit (RCW 42.56.550)
appeal.rule_text: Requester may ask the agency to review a denial (RCW 42.56.520(4)), optional and cannot be required; suit under RCW 42.56.550 must be filed within one year of the claim of exemption or last installment. AG written opinion available for state-agency denials (RCW 42.56.530), non-binding.

format_rule: Requester may choose any available format; no duty to create new records; customized database searches allowed (RCW 42.56.120(3)).
notes: Read chars 0-200k. Unit of the 5-day rule not labeled in RCFP; left null. Governor: broad agency definition, qualified communications privilege (Freedom Found. v. Gregoire). Legislature: individual legislators' offices are agencies, full House/Senate are not (AP v. Legislature 2019). Universities and school districts not explicitly addressed. 365 = one year. Response days kept null: RCFP says 'five days' without a unit; the 5-day rule is a response-or-estimate requirement, not a production deadline.
